test_title: PYST 17: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 24 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: The value of a car depreciates at the rate of 50 percent per annum. If its present value is Rs. 75000, then what was the value of the car 3 years ago?
solution:
**Given:**

Depreciation rate = 50% per annum

Present value of the car = Rs. 75000

**Formula Used:**

Value after n years = Present Value × (1 - Depreciation Rate)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

Let the value of the car 3 years ago be P.

Depreciation rate = 50% = 0.5

n = 3

Present Value = P × (1 - 0.5)³

75000 = P × (0.5)³

75000 = P × 0.125

⇒ P = 75000 / 0.125

⇒ P = 600000

**The value of the car 3 years ago was Rs. 600000.**
